insight: The Browser Company sunset Arc to focus on Dia, then was acquired by Atlassian for $610M in 2025.
name: Dia
tagline: An AI-native web browser with chat and skills built into the URL bar.
description: An AI-native desktop web browser from The Browser Company, the team behind Arc. Dia bakes a chat assistant and reusable 'skills' directly into the address bar, with awareness of your open tabs and browsing history, so you never need to copy context into a separate chatbot. It launched publicly on macOS in 2025 and is now available on Windows too. A free tier covers light AI use; paid plans start at $10/month for higher AI usage limits.

changelog.summary: Windows version now available (was macOS-only) and pricing restructured — entry paid tier is $10/mo (Better Answers); the old $20/mo Pro tier is gone.

edge: From the makers of Arc; AI lives in the address bar aware of your open tabs and history, not a bolted-on chatbot.
pros: AI baked into the URL bar
cons: Paid tiers from $10/mo to lift AI limits
